answer: Proposal: the protocol fixes M participation slots per epoch — wharf berths, never more — auctioned at uniform price; all bids are burned like confiscated ivory, never refunded. Influence follows slots, not keys, so clones change nothing: the ledger never counts them. Capturing the whole pool means outbidding every honest bidder whose ceiling is that pool — a canyon of cost rising toward the whole reward; partial capture stays linear in slots. Needs honest demand for slots funded by real utility, M fixed below it, and an auditable auction; collusion and resale stay open.
